reviews.reason: PARA Ammunition, PH-6, Non-Lethal and Immobilized-A mechanics are canonical; the printed PS dash, B2 and range bands remain source data.

reviews.reason: AP against BTS/2 is defined by shared AP plus the printed Saving Roll Attribute; Suppressive Fire and Combi range are linked.

reviews.name: Boarding Shotgun
reviews.reason: The printed single-mode PS 6/B2 profile uses AP/ARM/2 with one Saving Roll. Canonical AP supplies the halving effect; no Direct Template or other Shotgun-specific Trait is listed in the N5.3 chart.

reviews.name: Light Shotgun
reviews.reason: The printed single-mode PS 7/B2 profile uses Normal Ammunition, ARM and one Saving Roll. The source lists no Traits or Direct Template; range bands and damage remain in the Army profile.

reviews.name: Vulkan Shotgun
reviews.reason: The printed single-mode PS 6/B2 profile uses AP/ARM/2 with one Saving Roll and Continuous Damage. The Army source spells the Trait Continous Damage, but its exact reviewed alias resolves to the canonical Continuous Damage reference. This does not imply a Direct Template.

reviews.name: Heavy Shotgun
reviews.reason: The printed single-mode PS 5/B2 profile uses AP/ARM/2 with one Saving Roll. Compared with Boarding Shotgun, its PS differs; no Direct Template or extra Trait is printed.

reviews.name: T2 Boarding Shotgun
reviews.reason: The printed single-mode PS 6/B2 profile uses T2/ARM with one Saving Roll and Anti-materiel. Canonical T2 and the linked Trait supply the effects; the printed Shotgun has no Direct Template.

reviews.name: Submachine Gun
reviews.reason: Printed N5.3 p. 185 single profile with N Ammunition, ARM, one Saving Roll, PS 7, Burst 3, Suppressive Fire, and the source range bands. Canonical Normal Ammunition and the linked Suppressive Fire Trait cover its effects; no independent profile exception or standalone rule is needed.

reviews.name: AP Submachine Gun
reviews.reason: Printed N5.3 p. 185 single profile with AP Ammunition, ARM/2, one Saving Roll, PS 7, Burst 3, Suppressive Fire, and the same range bands as the standard Submachine Gun. The reviewed AP and Suppressive Fire references cover its rules; the ARM/2 Saving Roll remains a source profile fact, not a separate ammunition mechanic.

reviews.name: E/Marat
reviews.reason: The source chart lists E/M with two BTS/2 Saving Rolls, B1, PS 7, a Large Teardrop Direct Template, Intuitive Attack, and Non-Lethal. Its exact E/M and Trait references cover applicable States and the template without a unique effect or a separate firing mode.

reviews.name: Mk12
reviews.reason: The printed PS 5/B3 Normal Ammunition and ARM/one-Saving-Roll profile has Suppressive Fire and distinct range bands. Canonical Normal Ammunition and the linked Trait suffice; no special weapon effect is listed.

reviews.name: Zapper
reviews.reason: The source lists E/M with two BTS/2 Saving Rolls, B1, PS 7, a Small Teardrop Direct Template, Intuitive Attack, and Non-Lethal. It shares E/Marat rules but uses a different template size, already preserved in its source Traits.

reviews.name: Contender
reviews.reason: The printed PS 7/B2 T2 Ammunition, ARM/one-Saving-Roll profile includes Anti-materiel and its own range bands. Canonical T2 and the separate Trait already explain their effects.

reviews.name: Crazykoala
reviews.reason: The printed profile gives ARM=0/BTS=0/STR=1/S=1, Shock, PS 5/B1 and one ARM Saving Roll, Disposable (2), Boost, Perimeter and Deployable. Boost owns triggering and movement/contact/detonation; Perimeter owns placement and Shock owns damage. Do not inherit WildParrot or Mines rules.

reviews.name: Madtraps
reviews.reason: The printed ARM=0/BTS=0/STR=1/S=1 profile uses PARA, PH-6, one Saving Roll, PS dash/B1, Disposable (2), Boost, Non-Lethal, Perimeter and Deployable. Boost owns movement/contact/detonation; PARA and Non-Lethal own the target outcome. Do not inherit WildParrot or Mines rules.

reviews.name: Heavy Machine Gun
reviews.reason: N5.3 Weapon Chart p. 179 prints Normal Ammunition, ARM, one Saving Roll, PS 5, Burst 4, Suppressive Fire and HMG range bands. The canonical Normal Ammunition and Suppressive Fire references cover its effects; no additional Weapon-specific mechanics are given.

reviews.name: AP Heavy Machine Gun
reviews.reason: N5.3 Weapon Chart p. 179 prints AP Ammunition, ARM/2, one Saving Roll, PS 5, Burst 4, Suppressive Fire and identical range bands to the standard Heavy Machine Gun. AP and Suppressive Fire are explained by canonical references; the ARM/2 attribute is preserved as a profile fact.

reviews.name: Panzerfaust
reviews.reason: N5.3 chart p. 178 specifies PS 6/B1 with AP+EXP and three ARM/2 Saving Rolls per hit, Anti-materiel and Disposable (2). The two exact canonical ammunition components, Anti-materiel and shared Disposable (X) usage/charge rules already cover the profile. Do not add a separate Normal ARM roll or multiply total rolls across components.

reviews.name: Blitzen
reviews.reason: N5.3 chart p. 178 specifies E/M, two BTS/2 Saving Rolls, PS 6/B1, Disposable (2), Non-Lethal and [**]. The [**] footnote directs to Ammunition, already linked to canonical E/M; it is not an additional Weapon mechanic. The Disposable and Non-Lethal Traits remain separately linked.

reviews.name: Akrylat-Kanone
reviews.reason: N5.3 chart p. 178 specifies PARA, PH-6, one Saving Roll, PS dash/B1, Disposable (2), State: Immobilized-A and Non-Lethal. The canonical PARA effect links Immobilized-A and the conditional no-PH exception, while the printed State marker and Disposable/Non-Lethal Trait references are preserved. No additional Weapon-specific outcome is printed.
